summary: Fractal web: show transcript images on request through authorized attachment chunk reads, with bounded viewer URL caching, clear read states and retryable failures

schema.detail: Uses existing Attachment size metadata, TimelineMessageBody attachments and blob chunk read contract. No generated wire contract changes.

compatibility.detail: Image bytes are read only after Show image. Reads retain the native message carrier and viewer authorization; upload preview URLs are never reused. Unknown native content size remains unavailable.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; image attachments remain available as deferred cards.
